problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration, measured in $\text{m}/{\text{s}}^{2},$ given by the function $a(t)=2t-4,$ where $t>0$ is the time in seconds.  The positive direction is left to right. If the particle has velocity $v=12\,\text{m}/\text{s}$ when $t=6\,\text{s},$ determine the time intervals in which the particle moves to the left.

activity_context.topic_title: Determining Characteristics of Moving Objects Using Integration
